symptom: `DESCRIBE microflow` on the **modelsdk** engine emits a REST `body mapping X` line with no `from $var`, which fails to re-parse (`mismatched input … expecting FROM`) — breaks the DESCRIBE roundtrip
cause: `restRequestHandlingFromRaw` read the export-mapping source variable from the wrong key `ParameterVariable`; the real storage key is `MappingVariableName` (same key ExportXmlAction uses), so it came back empty and the renderer dropped the grammar-mandatory `from $var`
insight: Read `ParameterVariable` from `MappingVariableName` (fallback to `ParameterVariable`). Note this makes modelsdk *more* faithful than legacy, whose `parseRequestHandling` drops the REST request body mapping entirely ("would be parsed here if needed")
